description.fun: No two Spinda are quite alike: the spots on its face and ears land in a different pattern on each one, and Pokédex entries put the odds of two matching at less than one in four billion. It totters about in a dizzy dance that makes it hard to hit, all while believing it's walking in a straight line. Its staggering steps resemble the 'drunken boxing' style of martial arts.
description.guide: A Normal-type Pokémon resembling a panda with rabbit-like features, whose spot pattern is unique to each individual. It lives in the mountains, and its tottering dance confuses opponents. It does not evolve.
description.tagline: A dizzy panda whose spot pattern is different on every one
